title: Thu 22 Oct 2026: Nasdaq leads Wall Street higher, UK inflation hits 3.5% ahead of Budget, FCA crypto consultations, cheap money market fund
summary: Wall Street rallies on tech earnings while Asia slides on AI spending worries and Brent holds near one hundred and nine dollars. UK inflation rises to three point five percent, putting a Bank of England hike on the fifth of November in play ahead of next Wednesday's Budget, the Fed and the ECB. In regulation, the FCA opens DeFi and crypto perimeter consultations and closes its Home REIT probe; in funds, a new ultra-low-cost money market fund and more buffer ETF launches. Plus three COO action points and the diary.
